definitions.gloss: seal registration; registering a personal seal with the government
definitions.explanation: The process of officially registering a personal seal with the local municipal government. Once registered, the seal becomes a {実印|じついん} and can be used for important legal transactions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}したら→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧{印鑑登録|いんかんとうろく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧し{直|なお}す⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: You need to re-register your seal when you move.

examples.japanese: {印鑑登録|いんかんとうろく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{市区町村|しくちょうそん}→市区町村：23061_shikuchouson⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|おこな}います→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Seal registration is done at your local municipal office.

examples.japanese: {印鑑登録|いんかんとうろく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{身分証明書|みぶんしょうめいしょ}→身分証明書：09809_mibunshoumeisho⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧です。
examples.english: ID is required for seal registration.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{印鑑|いんかん}→印鑑：05290_inkan⟧ (seal) + ⟦{登録|とうろく}→登録：05703_touroku⟧ (registration)

REGISTRATION REQUIREMENTS:
- ⟦{本人|ほんにん}{確認|かくにん}→本人確認：15142_honninkakunin⟧⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧ - ID documents
- ⟦{登録|とうろく}する→登録する：25227_tourokusuru⟧⟦{印鑑|いんかん}→印鑑：05290_inkan⟧ - the seal to register
- ⟦{登録|とうろく}→登録：05703_touroku⟧⟦{手数料|てすうりょう}→手数料：05423_tesuuryou⟧ - registration fee (varies by municipality)

AFTER REGISTRATION:
You receive an {印鑑登録証|いんかんとうろくしょう} (registration card). This card is needed to obtain {印鑑証明書|いんかんしょうめいしょ} (seal certificate) when required for official transactions.

SEAL REQUIREMENTS:
⟦{登録|とうろく}できる→登録する：25227_tourokusuru⟧⟦{印鑑|いんかん}→印鑑：05290_inkan⟧:
- Size: usually 8mm-25mm
- Material: durable (⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧, ⟦{角|つの}→角：02158_tsuno⟧, {象牙|ぞうげ}, チタン, etc.)
- Clear impression
- Shows registrant's name

⟦{登録|とうろく}できない→登録する：25227_tourokusuru⟧⟦{印鑑|いんかん}→印鑑：05290_inkan⟧:
- Mass-produced (100⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧⟦ショップ→ショップ：08913_shoppu⟧ type)
- Rubber stamps
- Damaged or unclear impressions

IMPORTANT NOTES:
- One person can register only one seal
- Registration is tied to your ⟦{住民票|じゅうみんひょう}→住民票：09628_juuminhyou⟧ address
- Must re-register when moving to a new municipality
